atom_map.rule: VF2 heavy maps (P.map0 / map1) -> H via owner heavy atom (values = mean of the owned reactant H; edges one-to-one within owner groups) -> automorphisms of the reactant heavy graph (fragmenter labels) fixing the 5 reacting atoms, score = min(proper, improper) Kabsch RMSD on heavy atoms, lowest wins

excluded_reactions.reason: extension self-check failed (TS json dipole mismatch)

AW.energy: sum of atom contributions (+ phi(global) for A+G)

training.pairs: d1_train.masks arm C, T1 outer folds 0-4; train = outer-train T_main, test = test-side P_sens | A_main; pairs without atom data dropped
training.standardisation: per fit, training reactions / pairs only; numeric columns with sd < 1e-12 get sd = 1.0 (kept, centred only; rev 9 dropped such columns); y / std(y_train) per target (ddof 0), no mean removed
training.loss: mean |yhat - y| (standardised, 10 targets) + 0.1 * mean |yhat_bar*s_bar - sum_9 yhat_c*s_c| / s_bar
training.augmentation: random (a,b)/(b,a) order per pair and epoch, y sign flipped with it
training.tuning: first inner GroupKFold(4) fold by core (S_splits.json); cell = lowest validation MAE (standardised, mean of 9 primary targets), ties by grid order; best epoch
training.final: all outer-train pairs, best epoch on the same cosine schedule, seeds 20261019 + 0..4, prediction = mean (seed sd stored)

gpu.enforcement: submit flags; GPU name in every unit fingerprint; run_unit stops on a cache from another GPU; collect does not compare it; Phase E stops unless all units carry one RTX A6000 name
gpu.nondeterminism: allowed and recorded (seeds fixed, cudnn.deterministic True, benchmark False)

representative.per_target: for each of the 6 configs and each outer fold: the chosen cell's inner-validation MAE for the target at the best epoch, converted to kcal/mol by x s_y of that fold's tuning fit (std, ddof 0, of the target over the first-inner-fold training pairs with atom data; recomputed from the split files); mean over the 5 outer folds; lowest = representative
representative.ties: exactly equal float64 means; stable order AW-A, AW-A+G, GNN-A, GNN-A+G, TF-A, TF-A+G

main_comparison.c_xgb: existing arm C XGB, original rev 9 grid; predictions from $D1PAIR_SCRATCH/M/units/T1/T1__C__XGB__*.parquet (comparator_sha256)
main_comparison.test_pairs: T1 folds 0-4 test pairs in P_main, pooled over the 5 folds; pairs without atom data removed from both models

bootstrap.unit: core (cores of the pooled P_main test pairs resampled with replacement)

decision.rule: count targets with Holm p < 0.05 and CI lower bound > 0
decision.>=5: atom input better than the 182 features

secondary_comparisons_uncorrected.same_pairs: within each split the same test pairs for every model (pairs without atom data removed identically); same bootstrap as the main comparison

m4.representative_variant_per_model: variant with the lower T1 5-fold mean of the 9-target standardised validation MAE used for cell selection; ties: A first
